commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step 1: create opsadmin user =="
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
fi
id opsadmin

echo "== step 2: install authorized_keys =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh
echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid' | sudo -n tee /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys >/dev/null
sudo -n chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n chmod 700 /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
echo "authorized_keys content:"
sudo -n cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys

echo "== step 3: enforce key-based auth only =="
sudo -n tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
PermitEmptyPasswords no
EOF
cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf

echo "== step 4: validate and reload sshd =="
sudo -n sshd -t
sudo -n systemctl reload sshd
systemctl is-active sshd

echo "== step 5: effective config verification =="
sudo -n sshd -T | grep -Ei '^(passwordauthentication|pubkeyauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|permitemptypasswords)'
